mechanism: settle removes the existing-receipt replay check, so retrying the same request ID deducts the same 80 g again; after a first settlement leaves 70 g, retry incorrectly clamps the estimate to 0 g.
trigger: A settlement request for 80 g succeeds against 150 g estimated stock, but the client times out and retries the same request ID.
expectedBehavior: The retry returns the saved receipt and leaves the already-updated estimate at 70 g.
incorrectBehavior: The same 80 g is deducted again and the estimate falls to 0 g.
reproduction: Call the before and after fixture with {"recorded": 150, "actual": 80, "requestId": "req-1"}; compare the result to verify the described behavior.
unacceptableAllegations: the fixture directly executes a production database migration
the fixture proves unrelated application behavior
